sahneler.metin: An airliner dove into the sea off Indonesia.
It broke apart at high speed, and all one hundred two aboard were killed.
A navigation unit had been faulty for weeks.
In flight, both pilots worked on it.
The jet slowly rolled and nobody noticed.
When they did, it was in a steep spiral dive.
Indonesia tightened maintenance oversight and training.

aciklama:
Adam Air 574 dove into the sea off Sulawesi. The cause: autopilot disengagement while the crew was distracted, leading to an unrecovered spiral dive.
